name: harness-sdk
description: Build an agent harness and control it end-to-end. Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript - any model, any cloud.
one_liner: A developer kit for building the control system ('harness') that runs an AI agent end-to-end, so companies don't have to build agent infrastructure from scratch.
buyer: An engineering team at a company building a custom AI agent product who needs production-grade agent infrastructure instead of duct-taping their own.
business_use_cases: A startup building a custom vertical AI agent (e.g. legal-research agent) uses it as the underlying harness instead of writing agent orchestration code themselves.
A systems integrator standardizes every client's custom agent build on this SDK, cutting delivery time on future projects.
An enterprise platform team uses it to run the same agent across AWS and their own cloud without rewriting orchestration logic per provider.

money_ideas.idea: Offer custom agent-build consulting for companies standardizing on this SDK.
Provide a managed hosting/ops layer for companies who want the SDK's flexibility without running their own infrastructure.

steal_this: Build one small reference agent (e.g. a 'research assistant' that searches and summarizes) on top of it, publish it as a template, and offer paid customization to the first company that wants their own version.
